_about: Manual decisions the publisher always applies on top of what the AI read, so a re-run or the weekly refresh can never undo them. 'hold' keeps a trip or an operator off the site; 'tour' fields replace the record's; 'tiers' sets room-sharing prices per person by tier key. Every entry says why.

operators.k2trekkingandexpedition.com: hold: its dates table lists K2 departures in December, which can't happen; the dates can't be trusted
operators.jasminetours.com: hold: both trips share one template dates/price table ($1,800 for a Broad Peak expedition)

https://rozefstourism.com/tour/hunza-hon.why: 'From Rs. 190,000' on a couples page; per person vs per couple not stated

https://www.0km.com.pk/tour/kashmir-neel.why: 'Double Sharing Rs. 55,000' is for 2 adults, as the same operator labels it on its Mega Trip page

https://adventurertreks.pk/packages/by-r.why: page: 'Starting From: Rs 111,000 For 02 Persons' (the AI missed it)

https://adventurertreks.pk/packages/by-a.why: page: 'Starting From: Rs 254,000 For 02 Persons' (the AI missed it)

https://www.tourrangers.pk/tours/rakapos.why: page offer price PKR 60,000 ('From Rs 60,000 per person'); loaded by the page's booking box
